signal: Simpro launched Lightning, an AI-native operating platform with the Cooper AI layer, plus a Fast Cash AR automation agent in Q1 2026

email.body1:
George, saw Simpro launch Lightning with Cooper and the Fast Cash AR automation agent this year.

A launch like that spikes inbound and intent, but the lag between a signal firing and a rep acting is where most of that demand quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up the moment a signal hits, autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Simpro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
George, quick follow-up for Simpro.

Most RevOps leaders can see the signals firing but can't act on all of them fast enough, so slow response time and patchy data hygiene quietly cap the lift. Tightening that loop is usually the cheapest, fastest pipeline you'll find this quarter.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, 3 specific things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
George, last bit of proof for Simpro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Simpro's reply rate likely compares to peer field-service-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
George, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new AI platform is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Simpro either way.
